name: AL Language XApp C
brief: Cross-app fixture C: extends a page of cross-app fixture B without depending on the app that declares a type the page uses.
description: A page extension of cross-app fixture B's page and subscribers of the cross-app order probe. Depends on cross-app fixtures B, A and D (in this order on purpose: the declared order is not the app id order of A and B; writer UI), and on purpose not on the AL Internals Test Fixture. The app id, name and publisher are fixed on purpose: they decide the candidate orders of the cross-app subscriber order probe (CONTRIBUTING.md, "Multi-app fixtures"). Do not change them.
